title: A predictive winner among models that share a false bridge
question: When candidate models share a bridge assumption across a disconnected network, does a predictive criterion computed on observed trials rank them by their cross-gap error?
design: Two disconnected subnetworks linked by exchangeable baselines with a design nuisance of varying size; three candidate models sharing the bridge ranked by leave-one-trial-out predictive density. 6 cells, 1000 replicates each.
